role: Swarm orchestrator — subscribes to signals from every other bot and correlates them, surfacing a distinct incident when multiple independent bots corroborate a problem within a short window, rather than treating each bot's signal in isolation.
behaviorDescription: Subscribes to the shared swarm signal bus via activate(). On every incoming signal (ignoring its own, to prevent self-correlation), records it and checks whether at least 2 distinct bots have signaled within a 60-second window. If so, records a Decision and signals the swarm with a correlated-incident summary (types involved, distinct bot IDs, signal count). Fires at most once per window per cooldown, so a burst of corroborating signals doesn't spam repeated incident alerts for the same underlying cluster. Never scans files, never blocks or gates another bot's action — correlation and alerting only.
hardStops: Never blocks, gates, or overrides another bot's action — correlation and alerting only
Ignores its own emitted signals to prevent self-correlation feedback loops
Signals at most one correlated incident per correlation window (cooldown), to avoid alert storms
Never touches the filesystem or executes external commands
